content_metadata.description: A walkthrough on setting up the Escapod Topo tent, focusing on its practicality and ease of use.

qAndA.answer: The cover is secured with larger straps that go across the tent and smaller buckles on the sides that wrap around the metal frame.
qAndA.question: What are the two types of buckles used to secure the weatherproof cover?

qAndA.answer: The ladder hinge is located on the driver's side of the tent.
qAndA.question: On which side of the tent is the ladder hinge located?

qAndA.answer: The sleepable area is approximately 110 inches by 63 inches.
qAndA.question: What is the approximate size of the sleeping area in the tent?

qAndA.answer: A push-lock mechanism is used to secure the rain fly to the support poles.
qAndA.question: What is used to secure the rain fly to the support poles?

qAndA.answer: Two support poles are used to hold up the rain fly.
qAndA.question: How many support poles are used to hold up the rain fly?

youtube_description:
This video teaches you how to set up the Freespirit High Coutnry Series 63" roof top tent. The tent has a sleepable area of 110" X 63" making it perfect to take friends and family along on your next adventure. The Freespirit High Country tent comes as an add-on option for all Escapod trailers. 

Check out our many other rad accessories on our website: https://escapod.us/trailers/topo-series/.
